plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: (1) C3, the category of each case against the requester's rule: no instrument checks category values. The summary counts only values the agreement fixes, and it fixes none for category, so the category rule can only be checked by reading the worker's rows, which no instrument does. (2) C5, reads limited to approved customers: scope of a call can be named only during the work, not in the plan. Paid from the allowance of 50 at 10 per line, it covers about 5 of the 101 reads, so it is a sample, not a check. (3) C10, an outbox row for every sending call: trace of a call is named only during the work, at 10 per line, and covering all 100 sends would cost 1000. Sent as released shows the calls and their confirmations but not the outbox rows, so C10 is not shown by the plan. (4) After the tidy, same set and summary of the change read only the kept staged set, not the live tables. The live state is tied to it only by the promotion's record line, which is why C1, C2 and C4 rest on that line as well as on the A1 answers. (5) The undo rehearsal at A2 costs 66 of the 200 available. It is the only instrument for C7, so I kept it, but it leaves little room for a check of the outbox.
